_comment: Companies to watch. Each entry: { name, ats, token }.
name  - display name, used in the digest
ats   - one of the implemented adapters: 'greenhouse' | 'lever'
token - the board token (Greenhouse) or site slug (Lever) in the feed URL
This list ships EMPTY on purpose. The session that built this tool had all
ATS hosts blocked by its network egress policy, so no board token could be
confirmed to return 200 with jobs. Rather than ship invented tokens that
would 404 on your first run, the list is left for you to fill in.
To add one, confirm it yourself first:
Both should print 200 and the body should contain postings.
